## System Messages

### 301 - 321

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60043">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />301 - Liquid batch scheduler started</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60043">

When FcBatchScheduler.exe is started, this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Liquid batch scheduler started
- Data 1 Usage: Creation Date
- Message Class: Information
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60044">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />302 - Liquid batch scheduler finished</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60044">

When FcBatchScheduler.exe finishes creating scheduled batches, this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Liquid batch scheduler finished
- Data 1 Usage: Creation Date
- Message Class: Information
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60045">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />303 - Liquid batch scheduler error occurred</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60045">

When FcBatchScheduler.exe is unable to save a scheduled batch due to an unexpected error, this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Liquid batch scheduler error occurred
- Data 1 Usage: Creation Date
- Message Class: Information
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60046">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />304 - Product setup change (base density)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60046">

When the density value on the characteristic tab in the product editor is modified, this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Product setup change (base density)
- Data 1 Usage: Product Name
- Data 2 Usage: Old Value
- Data 3 Usage: New Value
- Message Class: Information
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="60047">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />305 - Product setup change (base density unit)</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="60047">

When the density unit on the characteristic tab in the product editor is modified, this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Product setup change (base density unit)
- Data 1 Usage: Product Name
- Data 2 Usage: Old Value
- Data 3 Usage: New Value
- Message Class: Information
- Message Priority: 5

</div>
